robo.h2: A plan built around your own knee.

fac.label: Under one roof
fac.h2: Everything your treatment needs, in one building.
fac.lede: Tests, surgery, blood, medicines and rehab happen here. For families travelling from villages and other districts, that means fewer trips and less waiting.
fac.t1p: Separate theatres for bone and eye surgery, built for clean air and infection control.
fac.t2p: Close monitoring after major surgery and in emergencies.
fac.t3p: Blood is arranged on site, so families do not have to run to another city during surgery.
fac.t4p: Images are taken and read during the same visit.
fac.t5p: Routine blood tests before surgery and during treatment.
fac.t6p: Prescribed medicines are available inside the hospital.
fac.t7p: Rehab starts in hospital and continues on follow-up visits.
fac.t8p: Quiet rooms to recover in after surgery.
fac.ctaH: Not sure a test is done here?
fac.ctaP: Ask on WhatsApp before you travel. The team will tell you what to bring.

visit.sum: The hospital is open day and night, all seven days. Emergency, admissions and the pharmacy never close. Book ahead to see a specific doctor.

stmt.p: For four decades, families from Punjab, Haryana and Rajasthan have come to one address for their bones, their eyes and their peace of mind. Today the second generation of the Gupta family runs three departments under one roof.
stmt.sig: Founded by Dr. Amrit Gupta in 1980

story.fig: Dr. Amrit Gupta with today’s doctors

items.p: Dr. Amrit Gupta starts an orthopaedic practice on Power House Road, bringing bone and joint surgery closer to families in Malwa.
Dr. Amit Gupta joins as psychiatrist and the de-addiction centre begins.
The hospital is empanelled under PM-JAY, so eligible card holders can be treated here.
The J&J VELYS™ robotic-assisted knee system is launched at the hospital’s Ortho Robotic Centre.
Tribune Health Care Award for excellence in joint replacement and ortho robotic surgery.
Dr. Mohit leads orthopaedics, Dr. Parul runs the eye department with its own operation theatre, and Dr. Amit heads mental health.

items.a: Booking ahead by phone or WhatsApp on +91 98787 52241 helps the team plan your visit and keeps your wait short.
Yes. The hospital is empanelled under PM-JAY. Bring your Ayushman card and Aadhaar, and eligibility is checked on the day.
Send a message on WhatsApp with your problem and any reports. The team will tell you which doctor to see.
Old reports, X-rays or scans, a list of the medicines you take now, and your Ayushman card if you have one.
